scope: First-party non-README documentation. Generated release copies, vendored/captured third-party documentation and generated schema outputs are excluded from edits. Supplemental structural checks may include generated first-party schemas.
source_snapshot_policy: Each repository report names its bounded implementation/evidence revision. A later main commit is not silently treated as audited. Local checks that include pending documentation are identified by file hashes or pending PR heads. Capability and acceptance claims require their named source, not an inventory row or passing mock.
self_reference_policy: The .github report may omit its own final head and PR URL in this generated artifact. Its containing Git commit and pull-request metadata are the authority for this artifact version; no recursive self-SHA is asserted.

discovery.method: Authenticated GitHub organization repository search, org filter, first page of 100; all 16 accessible matches returned in this snapshot.
discovery.inaccessible_repositories: Unknown. This inventory covers accessible matches; it cannot prove that no inaccessible repository exists.

counts.priority_note: Priority is the severity of a documentation remediation, not an implementation defect severity or a claim that an issue remains unresolved. Read remediation and outcome together.

capability_summary.configured_model_dispatch: gpt-6-luna, maximum reasoning effort; priority service tier exposed by dispatch; Fast flag and actual provider/usage telemetry are unknown.
capability_summary.available_main_capabilities: Public shared governance repository with a published pull-request template and five active issue forms, an inactive security draft, maintained contribution/agent/security/acceptance/release guidance, adoption records, workflow templates/examples, and an offline reusable-workflow fixture/test suite. Local tests execute the checker and fixture; no root workflow caller is installed, and destination adoption, detailed branch rules, hosted runs, private reporting route and master acceptance remain unverified or owner-pending.
capability_summary.documentation_change_boundary: First-party non-README documentation only; no application behavior, schemas, canonical semantics, configuration, issue-form fields, policy scope, acceptance state, GitHub settings, credentials, provider calls, workflow installation or deployment changed.
